up: Retrieve all exact activity values reported for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614410. Return the following columns for each activity record: molecule chembl id (molecule_chembl_id), standard type, standard relation, and standard value. Include all activity records for this assay without row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614410'
